summary.en: Ran and Sonoko brought Conan to an indoor tennis court. While Ran and Sonoko are playing tennis, Conan goes to the bathroom. As he is leaving, he hears a slap from the next room. He peeks into the room and see's a man named Takao Goto and a woman named Yuka Tsuchida arguing. Apparently Yuka is angry that Goto invited Sonoko as she thinks he wants to ditch her for Sonoko. As he apparently fixes everything up with her he leaves. She starts kicking the lockers saying, "Don't you dare leave me!" Meanwhile, Ran is looking for Conan where she meets one of the spectators named Fumihiro Azuma, who tells her he went to the restroom. Goto collapses in the middle of the match due to poisoning and is rushed to the hospital. Who is the culprit? Location: North Karuizawa Plateau Resort Park - Tennis Court Injury: Poison ivy rash Suspects: Yuka Tsuchida, Fumihiro Azuma, Chie Otake, and Sonoko Suzuki Takao Goto is about to serve on a tennis court (practicing). He collapses and has a weird mark on his hand. The cause of his collapse was found be poison.
